entry.title: RECAP - Romualdez cannot have personal staff with him in jail, says Ombudsman Remulla | GMA News

media:group.media:title: RECAP - Romualdez cannot have personal staff with him in jail, says Ombudsman Remulla | GMA News
media:group.media:description:
Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla on Friday said they will verify the information concerning former Speaker and Leyte Representative Martin Romualdez being accompanied by a personal staff while in detention in a Quezon City jail over a P7.4-billion plunder charge. #GMANews #SerbisyongTotoo #BreakingNews #VPonTrial

entry.title: RECAP - 79 flood control-related cases filed in courts, says Ombudsman | GMA News

media:group.media:title: RECAP - 79 flood control-related cases filed in courts, says Ombudsman | GMA News
media:group.media:description:
The Office of the Ombudsman has filed with Philippine courts 79 criminal cases related to the multi-billion peso flood control corruption scandal, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said Friday. #GMANews #SerbisyongTotoo #BreakingNews #VPonTrial
